title: Project Window & File Management
description: Navigate the Assets folder like a pro: search, labels, favorites, and import settings.

slides.title: The Project Window 🗂️
slides.content:
# Your Digital Asset Library

The Project window mirrors the `Assets` folder on disk. You can:
- Switch between **One‑Column** and **Two‑Column** layouts (small dropdown on the right).
- Use the **Favorites** section (top‑left) to bookmark folders.
- **Search** by name, type, label, or even script content (use `t:material` to find all materials).
- Right‑click to create new folders, scripts, scenes, materials, etc.

quizData.question: How do you find all materials in your project?
quizData.explanation: The Project window search supports type filters like t:material, t:script, etc.

slides.title: Labels, Assets & Import Settings 🏷️
slides.content:
# Organizing Your Assets

- **Labels**: In the Inspector for an asset, you can assign colored labels (red, blue, etc.) for easier visual sorting.
- **Asset Renaming**: Select and press **F2** (or slow double‑click) to rename.
- **Import Settings**: When you select an asset, the Inspector shows its import options (texture type, compression, animation rig). These determine how the asset is processed.

quizData.question: Where do you configure how a texture is compressed?

options.text: In the texture's import settings in the Inspector

quizData.explanation: Import settings for any asset are displayed in the Inspector when the asset is selected in the Project window.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Reimporting Assets

If an asset looks broken, right‑click it and select **Reimport**. Unity will re‑process it from the source file.
